page.overview:
Who is Samwell Tarly?

Samwell, born Samwell Tarly, and often called Sam, is Jon Snow's closest friend, the eldest son of Lord Randyll Tarly and Lady Melessa Tarly of Horn Hill, and the older brother of Dickon and Talla Tarly. Eventually he becomes the new Grand Maester.

Samwell Tarly is the oldest son and former heir of Lord Randyll Tarly, the head of House Tarly. House Tarly is one of the most powerful noble families in the Reach, and sworn to House Tyrell. By rights, Samwell would have grown up to be one of the top ranking lords of the Seven Kingdoms.

Randyll, one of the most skilled military commanders in Westeros, hoped for a son who would carry on his legacy and lead House Tarly into battle. Much to his dismay, his firstborn turned out to be an overweight scholarly-minded boy with no thirst for violence. Randyll, ashamed of his son, forced Sam to take the black under threat of death in order to disinherit him (though it is unknown if Randyll would really have done this). Sam departed for the Wall, leaving his younger brother Dickon as heir to House Tarly.

Sam was a virgin when he left for the Wall, and is a bit despondent about the restriction that his vows forbid him from ever taking a wife in the future.

Also known as: Sam, Samwell, Ser Piggy.
